name: MsoBarProtection
description: Specifies how a command bar is protected from user customization.

constants.name: msoBarNoProtection
constants.description: All aspects of the command bar can be customized by user.

constants.name: msoBarNoVerticalDock
constants.description: Command bar cannot be docked to the left or right.

constants.name: msoBarNoHorizontalDock
constants.description: Command bar cannot be docked to the top or bottom.
